steps.title: Request an appointment
steps.body: In WVSU Ticketon, go to Registrar → Appointment and enter:

steps.title: Check your ticket
steps.body: Read the Registrar’s reply for your appointment date and the documents to bring.

steps.title: Visit the Registrar
steps.body: On your scheduled date, get your Order of Payment.

steps.title: Pay and claim
steps.body: Pay at the Cashier, then return to the Registrar with your official receipt to claim your transcript.

activity.title: Get an Activity Design approved
activity.intro: For student organizations planning an event. Collect each signature in order: your college first, then the Student’s Center, then Administration.

steps.title: Write your activity design
steps.body: Use your organization’s template: objectives, date, venue, participants and budget. Print three copies.

steps.title: Get your adviser’s signature
steps.body: Your organization adviser reviews and signs all copies.

steps.title: Get the Dean’s endorsement
steps.body: Submit the signed copies to the CICT Dean’s Office for endorsement.

steps.title: USC endorsement
steps.body: Bring the endorsed copies to the USC Office for the council’s endorsement.

steps.title: OSA approval
steps.body: Submit to the Office of Student Affairs. They check the requirements and approve campus activities.

steps.title: President’s approval (off-campus only)
steps.body: For off-campus or overnight activities, OSA forwards it to the Office of the President. Wait for the approved copy.
